## What it catches

Workspace packages importing each other in a production cycle, even when no file-level cycle exists.

This rule is one of several in the Node preset. [The Node page](index.md) carries the full preset docs from [`packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md`](https://github.com/JakubSzwajka/house-rules/blob/main/packages/rules/docs/dependency-cruiser.md).
